user.title: Modbus One-Way Control
user.description:
**Add this integration once per device.** Enter a serial device path (e.g. /dev/ttyUSB0) or a **TCP address (e.g. tcp://192.168.110.158:6677)**.

With `tcp://` it sends over a **TCP client** connection (baud rate is ignored); with a path it uses the USB serial port.

Switches (`channels`) and buttons (`buttons`) go in /homeassistant/configuration.yaml under modbus_oneway_control:.

error.invalid_device: Enter an address: a serial path (e.g. /dev/ttyUSB0) or tcp://host:port.
error.invalid_tcp: Bad TCP address, expected e.g. tcp://192.168.110.158:6677.
